## Problem 1: NY NOAA

### Load the data and describe it
`ny_noaa` data contain the daily weather observations from 747 New York weather stations from 1981 through 2010. There are 2,595,176 rows and 7 columns. Each row represents one station-day. The measured variables are `prcp`, `snow`, `snwd`, and `tmax`/`tmin`. Missingness is noticeable, especially for max/min temperatures (44% NA) and snow depth (23% NA).
